column90: During the month to 30 June 2026, there were Share Issuances from Treasury totaling 2,373,000 Ordinary Shares for total consideration £6,394,580 at an average price of 268.88p per share
On 24 June 2026 the company bought 6,671,086 shares to be held in Treasury at a price of 47.45 pence per share.
